question: Do the two preregistered Mirror Oath research knobs preserve the complete frozen path at null and affect only acquisition eligibility or Afterimage producer eligibility when enabled, before any scientific simulator observation?

scientificBasis.acceptedTrigger: The immutable Mirror Oath capacity screen passed every frozen upper-capacity gate after exact current native grammar was exhausted.
scientificBasis.measuredBottleneck: Afterimage had broad acquisition and consumer opportunity but insufficient natural durable commitment. This preflight tests the exact research representation of one acquisition-and-play commitment carrier, not its balance value.
scientificBasis.minimality: Reuse the existing unlock-to-matching-tier path, status application law, Ward producer, Afterimage mediator, Warden's Edge consumer and all payoff values. Add no optimiser, policy threshold, scalar payoff, producer or consumer.
scientificBasis.claimBoundary: This is identity and direct-mediator evidence only. It cannot establish offer frequency, acquisition, play, complementarity, effect size, package admission, detector performance or product acceptance.

statusDefinition.name: Mirror Oath
statusDefinition.desc: Your Ward cards can form Afterimage.

mirrorOathPool.nullRule: Omitted or zero adds no unlock and executes the exact frozen profile and matching-tier pools.
mirrorOathPool.enabledRule: For Duskblade only, append exactly card:mirrorOath to the existing profile unlocks before RunState.new_run. Rewards.card_pool then appends exactly mirrorOath to the uncommon pool through the unchanged unlock path.
mirrorOathPool.intendedMediator: Mirror Oath offer and acquisition eligibility only.
mirrorOathPool.forbiddenDirectEffects: No card score, decline threshold, policy, base pool, other unlock, RNG call, combat state, Ashwarden pool or result may change directly.

mirrorOathGate.type: research-only binary deterministic Afterimage-producer eligibility factor
mirrorOathGate.nullRule: Omitted or zero preserves the exact frozen ungated Duskblade Ward-to-Afterimage path.
mirrorOathGate.enabledRule: For Duskblade only, suppress the existing Ward Afterimage status application while the player lacks the exact combat-duration mirrorOath status. Playing Mirror Oath permits the unchanged application.
mirrorOathGate.intendedMediator: Afterimage producer eligibility conditional on Mirror Oath status only.
mirrorOathGate.forbiddenDirectEffects: Ward, energy, HP, policy, score, target, RNG, Scoreline, Afterimage payoff, Warden's Edge, Ashwarden and every other status must remain exact.

scorelinePayoff.fixed: Exact frozen Scoreline and Faultline payoff path. This remains a separate causal factor and is not bundled with Afterimage.

afterimagePayoff.fixed: Exact frozen Warden's Edge Afterimage payoff. The gate changes producer eligibility, not payoff.

wardSetupPriority.fixed: Exact frozen Ward setup priority; no action-order intervention.

designMeaning: The three whole-run arms are deliberately aliased encodings of the same null path, not causal treatment cells and not a factorial. Each must reproduce every one of the 256 frozen rows exactly. Enabled levels occur only on fixed controlled surfaces that isolate their direct mediator.
mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: mirrorOathPool x mirrorOathGate is the later mechanism of interest because acquisition and play are required before the gate can permit Afterimage production.
mirrorOathGate x afterimagePayoff is mechanistically possible, but payoff is fixed and no interaction is estimated here.

aliasStructure.wholeRunNullAliases: pool-null-only, gate-null-only and joint-null all resolve to the same complete default settings. Their intentional alias is the identity estimand.
aliasStructure.controlledSurfaces: Pool isolation compares only unlock and uncommon-pool append fields. Gate isolation removes only the Afterimage status event, status field and their observation counters before requiring exact equality.
aliasStructure.noOutcomeAlias: No enabled whole-run cell exists, so this preflight cannot alias selection, acquisition, play or outcome effects.

anchors.frozenWholeRuns: The exact 64-policy by four-seed explicit-current rectangle from the identity-proved Momentum preference trace, including complete ordered trajectory, policy, RNG, package events and result.
anchors.poolPositiveControl: Duskblade mirrorOathPool 1 appends exactly card:mirrorOath and mirrorOath at the end of the existing unlock and uncommon-pool arrays without consuming RNG.
anchors.poolNegativeControl: Ashwarden mirrorOathPool 1 leaves unlocks, uncommon pool, policy, RNG and combat state exact.
anchors.gatePositiveControls: Duskblade Ward produces Afterimage at null, is suppressed when the gate is enabled without Mirror Oath, and produces the same Afterimage after Mirror Oath is played.
anchors.gateNegativeControls: Ward value, Ashwarden path and the complete Scoreline route remain exact across the gate contrast.
anchors.telemetryControl: Harvesting offer/acquisition/draw/play/gate/application/consumption counters leaves RNG, HP, Ward, energy, statuses, enemy state and the ordered event queue byte-equivalent before and after.

estimands.nullIdentity: For each frozen policy-seed identity and each of three null encodings, canonical equality of the complete row after removing only id, stage and arm labels.
estimands.poolDirectMediator: Enabled minus null for the ordered profile unlocks and uncommon pool on fixed Duskblade and Ashwarden controlled surfaces.
estimands.gateDirectMediator: Enabled minus null for the Afterimage application only, holding scripted cards, order, policy, aspect, enemy, seed and every non-mediator field exact.
estimands.carrierPositiveControl: Exact mirrorOath and afterimage status presence after Mirror Oath then Ward under the enabled gate.
estimands.separatePackageNegativeControl: Canonical equality of the exercised Chisel-to-Faultline Scoreline route across gate null and enabled.
estimands.telemetryInertia: Canonical equality of complete game state and RNG immediately before and after observation-only harvest.
estimands.trustBoundary: Level 2 for either registered knob must terminate the probe with exit code 2, an unregistered-level diagnostic and no output row.

surfaceDesign.identity: Every within-route contrast freezes aspect, seed, resolved policy, hand, order, target, enemy, energy, content and observation method.

frozenPath.name: identity-proved explicit-current arm from the Momentum preference CRN rectangle
frozenPath.comparison: Exact complete-row equality after removing only id, stage and arm labels.

cohort.identity: All 256 frozen identities are replayed under each null encoding. No policy or seed is selected, removed, replaced or added.

successRule: Every one of the 768 whole-run null replays is exactly equal to its frozen row; omitted and explicit null controlled surfaces are exact; pool enabled appends only the one Duskblade unlock and uncommon carrier without RNG or state movement; gate enabled changes only Afterimage producer eligibility; Mirror Oath satisfies that gate; Ashwarden and Scoreline negative controls are exact; telemetry harvest is state and RNG inert; both invalid levels fail closed; the exact 4.7.1 binary is used; and the ledger is byte-identical before and after.
futilityRule: Any complete-row mismatch, pool or gate direct-field leakage, missing positive control, changed Ashwarden or Scoreline control, telemetry state/RNG movement, accepted invalid level or ledger mutation rejects these knobs. Run no scientific row; close this scalar-free carrier family and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421.
inconclusiveRule: Immutable-input drift, missing or corrupt cache, unavailable exact Godot binary, unrelated process failure, unreadable ledger or timeout records an inconclusive result at this cap and gives no authority for a scientific row.
stoppingRule: Execute the fixed 13 controlled surfaces first, then the complete 768 null replay plan, then the two invalid-level checks. Stop at the first failure. Run once only; do not repair after looking at an outcome. No promising cell, adaptive cohort or extra row exists.

decisionBoundary.onSuccess: Freeze exactly Mirror Oath and the two identity-safe binary research knobs for a separately preregistered, mechanism-blocked equal-cohort CRN first look. Begin with comparable acquisition, play and mediator evidence; expand to whole-run or shared Scoreline interference cells only when measured decision value justifies them.
decisionBoundary.onFutility: Close the Mirror Oath carrier family and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421.
decisionBoundary.onInconclusive: Record the inconclusive result at the preregistered cap.

forbidden: any balance, package, detector, acceptance or product claim
any enabled whole-run treatment cell in this preflight
changing the card, status, payoff, producer, consumer, cohort, estimator or gate after execution begins
adding ML, RL, another optimiser or a policy threshold
writing any plan, run or observation to the append-only research ledger
